verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the GitHub README tagline listing "idempotency" among Trigger.dev's durable-task features. Checkpoint-resume durability and retries are documented, but nothing shows how idempotency keys are set or scoped, or that steps run exactly once. That is a single thin mention, so most of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented idempotency-key API (on trigger and inside tasks), key TTL/scope behavior, exactly-once or deduplication semantics for steps under retries, hands-on or independent corroboration that duplicates are prevented.
